name: comment_to_code_styles
description: One-line R comment for a real comment-free CRAN code block (reverse-synthetic: the corpus code is the ground truth, the LLM writes the comment a developer would have put above it). Migration of the 5-style comment generation from agy_generators.py mode c2c / comment_to_code.py PROMPTS into a declarative spec.
novelty_note: comment_to_code_synthetic and the agy c2c mode are one-off scripts with a single prompt distribution and hardcoded backend chains; this case makes the 5 comment STYLES (what/why/terse/inputs-transform-result/gotcha) first-class template rows of a spec, backend-agnostic (agy|zai|opencode|openrouter), with the comment gate as a registered validator, done-sidecar resume and per-row provenance. Row shape follows comment_to_code.make_synthetic_example exactly: prefix ends with the generated comment line, region_old is the empty cursor line, region_new is the real block.
